old: the live request of the same graph state (when `graphKey` is given) whose claim
new: the live request of a machine of its own platform class (a request of another class goes to `foreign` and is left to a machine of that class) of the same graph state (when `graphKey` is given) whose claim

old: /** 🗣️ One message of the texts table in one language. */
"alive": "graph-server: alive, {requesters} machines seen, {held} requests held, read {reading}",
new:
"alive": "graph-server: alive, {requesters} machines seen, {held} requests held, {foreign} of other platform classes left to others, read {reading}",
          "foreign": "graph-server: {count} stale projects of {requester} ({platform}) are left to a machine of the class {class}; this machine serves the class {own}",
          "class": "graph: this machine is {platform} (class {class}); only machines of that class serve its request, and their graph server logs 'serving' for it",

old: "alive": "Graph-Server: lebt, {requesters} Maschinen gesehen, {held} Anfragen gehalten, Lesen {reading}",
new:
"alive": "Graph-Server: lebt, {requesters} Maschinen gesehen, {held} Anfragen gehalten, {foreign} anderer Plattformklassen anderen überlassen, Lesen {reading}",
          "foreign": "Graph-Server: {count} veraltete Projekte von {requester} ({platform}) bleiben einer Maschine der Klasse {class} überlassen; diese Maschine bedient die Klasse {own}",
          "class": "Graph: diese Maschine ist {platform} (Klasse {class}); ihre Anfrage bedienen nur Maschinen dieser Klasse, deren Graph-Server meldet dafür 'bediene'",

old: a machine with headroom. A machine that may not serve
new: a machine with headroom. It serves the requests of every machine of its platform class (a slot is per requester, the request names the platform) and counts the others. A machine that may not serve

old: The admitted memory is half of what the host has (a declared smaller machine counts as declared), lowered to the grant a slice pool load runs under when it has one (the quiet forecast grant of a command says nothing about what the machine can give):
new: The admitted memory is half of what the host has (a declared smaller machine counts as declared), lowered to what is available now less a floor (`fleetAdmittedMegabytesV1`), never to the grant of the slice pool load that asks (a 2048 MB booking left a 16 GB worker a grant of 0 MB per project and a wave of 0 projects):

old: the digest of the record key (inference revision and the project's own identity) with the root replaced by the token, the platform, and one slot per project
new: the digest of the record key (inference revision and the project's own identity) with the root replaced by the token, the platform class (`posix-shared` for macOS and Linux, the exact platform for Windows and for a project whose key names a host-bound declaration), and one slot per project

old: a request is read back by requester and platform,
new: a request is read back by its requester alone whatever the platform of the reader,

old: differs when the key, the platform or the project differs
new: differs when the key, the platform class or the project differs
